changes.comment: Agent-authored MCP Apps widget registry (#1239): new widgets table + gRPC RPCs (RegisterWidget/UpdateWidget/GetWidget/ListWidgets) with workspace isolation; MCP tools widget_register/update/list/render/show (in the default scoped + orchestrator presets); the broker capture now emits dynamic agent-authored widgets via a result _meta descriptor; agent widget bodies render with inline scripts allowed (GRACKLE sandbox CSP allowInlineScripts) in the origin-isolated sandbox; web EventRenderer dispatches on rendererKind.
